mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the venous valves was most worthwhile: the planned muscle-compression picture explains how valves help direct blood toward the heart, rather than merely naming their function.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the lined veins was relatively repetitive after making the lined arteries, though it established the wall contrast.

surprise.text: The venous-return picture added contracting limb muscle to the explanation of how blood moves toward the heart; I had expected the valves alone to prevent backflow.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary: each vessel part had a visible role in the route.

continue.text: I would continue: assembling the route and seeing how wall structure relates to exchange and return made me curious about how it connects to the heart.
